description:
Recently built, this semi-detached family home offers a spacious living and dining room, complemented by a modern fitted kitchen. The property comprises three generously sized bedrooms and a well-appointed bathroom. Convenient off-street parking is available at the front, while the rear boasts a lawned garden with a paved patio area, perfect for outdoor relaxation. Situated in a popular development to the east of the city, residents benefit from a range of local amenities including a public house, restaurant, schools, and supermarkets within easy reach. With excellent access to both the city centre and the M6 Motorway, this property promises a convenient lifestyle for its occupants. Don't miss out on the opportunity to call this desirable home yours, offering comfort and convenience in a thriving location.

Directions From Carlisle city centre, head east on Warwick Road. At the Tesco traffic lights, turn right onto Montgomery Way, then right onto Durranhill Road, the first left onto Agricola Way.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
